text:
Predicates:
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
MonkeypoxVirus(x) ::: x is a monkeypox virus.
Infects(y, x) ::: y infects x.
Human(x) ::: x is a human.
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
Symptom(x, y) ::: y is a symptom of x.
FeelTired(x) ::: x feels tired.
Glu(x) ::: x gets a glu.
Question: based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? There is an animal.
Premises:
MonkeypoxVirus(y) ∧ OccursIn(y, x) ::: Monkeypox virus can occur in certain animals, including humans.
Human(x) ∧ Mammal(x) ::: Humans are mammals.
Mammal(x) ::: Mammals are animals.
Symptom(y, fever) ∧ Symptom(y, headache) ∧ Symptom(y, muscle_pains) ∧ Symptom(y, tiredness) ::: Symptoms of Monkeypox include fever, headache, muscle pains, feeling tired, and so on.
FeelTired(x) ∧ GetsGlu(x) ::: People feel tired when they get a glu.
Conclusion: There is an animal.
∃x (Animal(x))
